verdict.rationale: The evidence shows a Liquid templating layer (Liquid template validation, Liquid inclusions seen in storefront source) and a Shopify CLI that generates and works with themes and custom storefronts, with Hydrogen as a code-first headless option. Local theme preview and version-controlled theme deploys are not evidenced; the only local-dev item covers apps (`shopify app dev` against dev stores), and community feedback rates the storefront dev experience as mediocre. Missing for 10: documented local theme preview/dev server, Git-based or version-controlled theme deploy workflow, first-party Liquid reference docs, independent hands-on corroboration.
